Paid by clients and companies paying the fees (withholding); contractors pay quarterly advances. L.I.R. art. 135 and 152; the employment-contract test described on Guichet.lu.

source.title: Guichet.lu: Contrat à durée indéterminée (CDI), last modified 04.06.2026

rows.label: Simplified or flat-rate regimes for small businesses [national]
rows.value: none for income tax (profits taxed on the progressive scale); VAT franchise for turnover up to €50,000 a year. Paid by no one: the franchise is an exemption. L.I.R. (one scale for all income); AED rules on the small-business VAT franchise.

source.title: ACD: Barèmes, 1.3 Explications (last updated 18/04/2025)

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
rows.value: wage tax at the normal scale on pay for work in Luxembourg, withheld by the employer (class 1 or 1a; married: class 1); resident treatment on request where at least 90% of worldwide income is taxable in Luxembourg; 34-day telework thresholds with France, Belgium and Germany. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer). L.I.R. art. 2, 156, 157, 157bis and 157ter.

source.title: ACD: L.I.R., texte coordonné en vigueur au 1er janvier 2026 (date d'actualisation 08/05/2026), art. 2, 156, 157, 157bis and 157ter

rows.label: Property tax (impôt foncier) [municipal]
rows.value: unit value × base rate × the commune's multiplier; 2026 multipliers from 105% to 4000% by class and commune (Luxembourg City 250% to 750%). Paid by owners on 1 January. Loi modifiée sur l'impôt foncier du 1er décembre 1936 (Grundsteuergesetz).

source.title: ACD: Impôt foncier (last updated 24/01/2017); Guichet.lu: Impôt foncier (last modified 13.10.2022)

rows.label: Property transfer duties: registration and transcription duty (droits d'enregistrement et de transcription) [national]
rows.value: 6% registration plus 1% transcription; Bëllegen Akt credit of €40,000 per buyer for an own home; Luxembourg City surcharge of 50% of the registration duty on non-residential property. Paid by the buyer. Registration and transcription duties collected by the AED; loi modifiée du 30 juillet 2002 (crédit d'impôt); Ville de Luxembourg règlement-taxe.

source.title: AED, Portail de la fiscalité indirecte: Crédit d'impôt - 'Bëllegen Akt' (last updated 07/10/2026); Guichet.lu: Crédit d’impôt sur les actes notariés ('Bëllegen Akt'), last modified 07.07.2025

rows.label: Solidarity surcharge: employment fund contribution (contribution au fonds pour l'emploi) [national]
rows.value: 7% of the income tax; 9% above EUR 150,000 adjusted taxable income (classes 1 and 1a) or EUR 300,000 (class 2). Paid by all income taxpayers (included in wage tax withholding). L.I.R.; law on the employment fund.
rows.note: Checklist item A2; detailed table: employment-fund

source.title: ACD: A à Z, Fonds pour l'emploi (last updated 13/02/2024)

rows.label: Capital gains of individuals: speculative gains, substantial holdings and real estate (bénéfices de spéculation et plus-values) [national]
rows.value: securities held under 6 months and real estate sold within 5 years: ordinary rates; small holdings after 6 months exempt; substantial holdings (over 10%) and real estate after 5 years: half the global rate (at most about 21%), EUR 50,000 allowance per 10 years. Paid by resident individuals. L.I.R. art. 99bis, 99ter and 100.
rows.note: Checklist item A5; detailed table: capital-gains

source.title: Guichet.lu: Identifier et déclarer les revenus résultant de l'achat et de la vente d'actions ou de titres

rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (retenue d'impôt sur les revenus de capitaux) [national]
rows.value: 15% on dividends (treaty and parent-subsidiary relief); no withholding on ordinary interest or royalties paid to non-residents. Paid by Luxembourg companies paying dividends. L.I.R. art. 146 and following; tax treaties.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: investment-income

source.title: ACD: Taux de la retenue d'impôt à la source sur dividendes, intérêts, redevances, tantièmes et activités littéraires, artistiques et sportives (last updated 06/05/2024)

rows.label: Rental income and pension income [national]
rows.value: net rental income (receipts less expenses) and net pensions (minimum flat expense deduction EUR 300) are taxed at the progressive rates; losses from letting offset other income. Paid by resident individuals and non-residents on Luxembourg income. L.I.R..
rows.note: Checklist item A7

source.title: ACD: A à Z, Immeuble faisant partie du patrimoine privé du contribuable donné en location (last updated 24/02/2026)

rows.label: Value added tax (taxe sur la valeur ajoutée) [national]
rows.value: 17% standard, 14% intermediate, 8% reduced, 3% super-reduced; franchise up to EUR 50,000 turnover. Paid by businesses (passed on to consumers). loi TVA du 12 février 1979 and annexes A, B and C.
rows.note: Checklist item D1; detailed table: vat

source.title: PFI (AED): Taux nationaux applicables (last updated 28/12/2023)

rows.label: Excise duties: fuel, alcohol, beer and tobacco (accises) [national]
rows.value: from 1 July 2026: unleaded petrol EUR 526.38 and road diesel EUR 421.87 per 1,000 l (CO2 tax included); spirits EUR 1,123.10 per hl of pure alcohol; cigarettes 48.14% plus EUR 23.39 per 1,000. Paid by producers and importers (passed on to consumers). Belgium-Luxembourg Economic Union excise rules and autonomous Luxembourg excise.
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise

source.title: Administration des douanes et accises: Taux d'accises applicables pour l'année 2026 (nouveaux taux applicables à partir du 01.07.2026)

rows.label: Insurance premium tax and subscription tax on funds (impôt sur les assurances, taxe d'abonnement) [national]
rows.value: insurance tax 3% to 6% by type of policy, plus the fire and rescue services taxes; subscription tax 0.05% (0.01% reduced) on investment funds, 0.25% on SPFs. Paid by insurers; investment funds and family wealth companies. insurance tax law (Versicherungsteuergesetz of 9 July 1937); law on undertakings for collective investment.
rows.note: Checklist item D4; detailed table: insurance-premium-tax

source.title: Guichet.lu: Déclaration et paiement des impôts sur les assurances

rows.label: Electricity and natural gas excise (energy tax) (accise sur l'électricité et le gaz naturel) [national]
rows.value: electricity EUR 1.00 per MWh up to 25 MWh a year (EUR 0.50 above); natural gas for heating EUR 10.20 per MWh incl. CO2 tax (small consumers). Paid by suppliers (passed on to consumers). excise law on energy products and electricity.
rows.note: Checklist item D5; detailed table: energy-tax

source.title: Administration des douanes et accises: Taux d'accises applicables pour l'année 2026 (nouveaux taux applicables à partir du 01.07.2026)

rows.label: Wealth tax: none for individuals (impôt sur la fortune) [national]
rows.value: abolished for resident and non-resident individuals from 1 January 2006; companies remain subject to the net wealth tax. Paid by companies only. loi modifiée du 16 octobre 1934 concernant l'impôt sur la fortune.
rows.note: Checklist item E3

source.title: ACD: A à Z, Collectivités soumises à l'impôt sur la fortune (last updated 11/11/2022)

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax: succession and registration duties (droits de succession, droits de mutation par décès) [national]
rows.value: direct line and spouses exempt (2.5% or 5% on the direct-line share above the statutory share); siblings 6% / 15%; others up to 15%, plus surcharges of 1/10 to 22/10 above EUR 10,000; gifts 1.8% to 14.4% registration duty. Paid by heirs and legatees (non-residents' estates: Luxembourg real estate only). loi du 27 décembre 1817 sur les droits de succession.
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance-gift

source.title: PFI (AED): Successions, Exemptions (last updated 30/09/2020)

rows.label: Vehicle tax: annual road tax (taxe sur les véhicules routiers) (taxe sur les véhicules routiers) [national]
rows.value: annual tax on passenger cars based on WLTP CO2 emissions and fuel; minimum EUR 30 a year (e.g. electric cars); refund up to EUR 125 for households of at least 5 persons. Paid by vehicle keepers. loi du 22 décembre 2006.
rows.note: Checklist item F1

source.title: Administration des douanes et accises: Taxe sur les véhicules routiers (last updated 02/05/2025)

rows.label: CO2 tax on energy products (taxe CO2) [national]
rows.value: EUR 45 per tonne of CO2 in 2026, collected as an autonomous excise (e.g. EUR 122.02 per 1,000 l of petrol); CO2 tax credit EUR 216. Paid by fuel suppliers (passed on to consumers). excise law on energy products; Plan national énergie et climat.
rows.note: Checklist item F2; detailed table: carbon-tax

source.title: Gouvernement du Luxembourg: Nouveautés 2026 (December 2025)

rows.label: Customs duties, import VAT and cash controls (douane) [EU and national]
rows.value: EU customs tariff; cash declaration from EUR 10,000; EUR 3 duty per item on low-value parcels up to EUR 150 from 1 July 2026. Paid by importers and travellers. EU customs law; Regulation (EU) 2026/382; EU cash controls.
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs

source.title: Administration des douanes et accises: Contrôle des mouvements d'argent liquide

rows.label: Stamp duties on documents: registration duties (droits d'enregistrement) [national]
rows.value: EUR 12 fixed duty on deeds without a transfer of value; proportional duties such as 0.6% on leases, 2.4% on contracts for work, 6% on sales. Paid by parties to the deeds. loi du 22 frimaire an VII and later laws on registration duties.
rows.note: Checklist item H1; detailed table: stamp-duties
